messages:
zoe: quick check-in  i started a lightweight PR to add an automated redirect-map generator + migration checklist. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2401

pavel: nice. is the generator intended to create path-level 301s or HMAC-protected temporary redirects? ops prefers plain path 301s for CDN caching.

anya: generator idea sounds good. we should include a sample redirect map in the guide so infra can drop it straight into the router. also include exact SDK error text so support can grep logs.

zoe: sample redirect map i'm proposing (tiny):
```
# redirect-map.json (example)
[
  {"from": "/v1/api/generate", "to": "/v2/generate", "status": 301, "canary": 0.05},
  {"from": "/v1/embeds", "to": "/v2/embeds", "status": 301}
]
```

pavel: that works. please add a `rollback_flag` key and a `private_exempt` list so private/dedicated customers aren't redirected without AE contact.

anya: bring in the exact error string for snippets: "Error: 410 DeprecatedEndpoint: this endpoint has been removed; upgrade to client v2". include short code examples across JS/Python.

zoe: adding JS example for the error and an ops header hint:
```
// js
try { await client.call(...) } catch (e) {
  // e.code === 410 && e.message.includes('DeprecatedEndpoint')
}
// route header suggestion: 'X-Redwood-Client: v2'
```

ops-bot: Ops note: timeline request: 30-day soft banner, 10-day urgent banner, then 48h 5% canary -> 24h 50% -> full. must schedule canary with infra and include rollback playbook with flag toggle.

support: for support triage, include a one-line search query in the playbook: "410 DeprecatedEndpoint" OR "DeprecatedEndpointError". also include example stderr lines from SDKs.

zoe: checklist i'll add to PR: (1) redirect-map generator script, (2) banner copy with migration link, (3) language snippets + grepable errors, (4) smoke tests for snippets in docs CI (assert example outputs and vector lengths), (5) rollback runbook + infra contact list, (6) AE notify step for Dedicated/Private.

pavel: also add a tiny script example for the generator so teams can produce maps from a CSV of endpoints. e.g.:
```
# gen_redirects.py (concept)
# csv cols: from,to,canary
for row in csv: emit_json(row)
```

anya: will draft the small embed fallback pad helper and a note: "clients should re-normalize vectors after padding to keep cosine scores comparable."

docs-bot: Please add labels `migration`, `deprecation`, `automation`. CI will run snippet lint and the docs smoke tests on merge.

zoe: target merge = next Tuesday noon. i'll push updates and ping for quick reviews. thanks! :raised_hands:
